title: Introduction
slide_intent: Explain why the components belong together. Designers need a shared basis for making choices across six venues with different identities.
strategic_value: The manual can connect the six venues to one institution while giving designers a reason to apply its guidance creatively.
demonstration: Two large paragraphs beneath the title define the identity as a system and describe the role of consistency. The text occupies the left side of a mostly open white page.
practical_value: Use this page to brief a designer on the scope of the guidelines before choosing individual elements.
